opinion.semantics: Task asks for the writer's personal viewpoint/preference; no mandated evidence or counterargument structure.
opinion.trigger_class: explicit personal-viewpoint/preference/agree-disagree request WITHOUT an evidence or counterargument mandate

argumentative.semantics: Task mandates a position plus evidence-based argumentation (reasons/evidence and/or counterargument).
argumentative.trigger_class: stance mandate (take/defend a position) PLUS evidence/argument/counterargument mandate

discussion.semantics: Task requires balanced examination of two or more perspectives; no mandated final stance.
discussion.trigger_class: balanced multi-perspective requirement (both sides, advantages AND disadvantages, compare views) WITHOUT a mandated final stance

problem_solution.semantics: Task names a problem and requires cause/solution content.
problem_solution.trigger_class: named problem plus explicit solution/cause requirement

general_eap.semantics: Task is affirmatively an EAP writing task that matches no specific type under the current criteria.
general_eap.trigger_class: generic academic-writing instruction with no specific-type trigger (contract section 7 conditions)
